purpose: Investigate reported M11 refugee automatic movement/attack regression after mercenary art integration
findings: Both packages automatically wait while an enemy is within the escort danger radius.
Both packages resume automatic evacuation when the route is safe.
The real complete end-turn controller produces identical positions and HP changes in both packages, including melee counterattacks by M11_refugees1.
Normal-speed movement through the actual 0.8.8 animation controller completes for both escorts; no instant-mode movement bypass in this check.
The current turn-3 save has archers at (10,10) and (9,9), 3-4 tiles from the escorts, triggering the existing wait rule.
The quest escort branch does not request proactive attacks; old 0.8.0 has the same behavior.
limitations: 0.8.7 package is no longer present in current dist; comparison uses the available 0.8.0 package and current 0.8.8.
All behavior checks are headless; normal-speed movement uses real timers but no on-screen rendering.
The version and circumstances the user remembers as proactive attacking are not yet identified.
